guideTitle: The Best Desk Pads with Printed Planning Grids and Calendars
breadcrumbLabel: Best Desk Pads with Reference Charts
metaTitle: Best Desk Pads with Reference Charts and Calendars (2026)
metaDescription: Few desk pads include printed reference charts. We compared four calendar desk pads, which give dates at a glance, against four plain leather pads you can pair with your own chart.
introParagraphs: If you want information printed where you work, the closest thing among these picks is a desk pad calendar: a large paper grid of dates on the desk, some with extras such as Julian dates. None of the eight listings here describes printed reference charts such as conversion tables or shortcut sheets.

So this guide splits in two. Four calendar pads put dates and planning space in front of you; four leather or PU desk pads protect the desk, and you can keep your own reference sheet beside or under a clear protector.
Our comparison is based on listed sizes, date ranges and materials, not hands-on testing. Calendar pads are dated, so check the months covered before buying.

best-desk-pads-with-reference-charts-1.summary: A 22 x 17-inch, 18-month calendar (July 2026 to December 2027) on a reusable PU leather backboard.
best-desk-pads-with-reference-charts-1.description:
This calendar pad combines planning and desk protection: an 18-month paper calendar from July 2026 to December 2027, 22 x 17 inches, on a reusable double-layer PU leather backboard.

When the calendar runs out, the backboard can carry a new pad. Paper pages don't suit a mouse, so plan to keep your mouse to one side.
best-desk-pads-with-reference-charts-1.bestFor: Planning at a glance on a desk you also want protected.
best-desk-pads-with-reference-charts-1.skipIf: You only need a calendar year; the AT-A-GLANCE covers 2027 for less.

best-desk-pads-with-reference-charts-2.summary: A 32 x 16-inch, 2mm full-grain leather desk mat with matching accessories including a coaster.
best-desk-pads-with-reference-charts-2.description:
The Elizo set is a real leather option: a full-grain leather desk mat, 32 x 16 inches and 2mm thick, with matching desk accessories including a leather tray coaster.

It has no printed charts or calendar; it's here as a durable base for your own reference sheets.
specs: Accessories: matching set incl. tray coaster
best-desk-pads-with-reference-charts-2.bestFor: A leather desk surface with coordinated accessories.
best-desk-pads-with-reference-charts-2.skipIf: You want dates on the desk; a calendar pad suits that.

best-desk-pads-with-reference-charts-3.summary: A 17 x 12-inch 2027 calendar with 2.3-inch daily squares on 120gsm paper.
best-desk-pads-with-reference-charts-3.description:
The Taja calendar is the least expensive option here: a 17 x 12-inch 2027 calendar with 2.3 x 2.3-inch daily squares on 120gsm paper.

It's smaller than a full desk pad, so it sits beside the keyboard rather than under it.
best-desk-pads-with-reference-charts-3.bestFor: A compact monthly planner on the desk.
best-desk-pads-with-reference-charts-3.skipIf: You want the calendar under your keyboard; the 22 x 17-inch pad is larger.

best-desk-pads-with-reference-charts-4.badge: Best PU Leather Pad with Felt Base
best-desk-pads-with-reference-charts-4.summary: A stitched PU leather desk mat with a non-slip felt base for glass or wood desks.
best-desk-pads-with-reference-charts-4.description:
The Gallaway is a stitched PU leather desk mat with a non-slip felt base that Gallaway says stops it sliding on glass or wooden desks.

It has no printed content, and its size isn't given in the listing summary.
best-desk-pads-with-reference-charts-4.bestFor: A glass or wood desk that needs a non-slip pad.
best-desk-pads-with-reference-charts-4.skipIf: You want a stated size; the Aothia lists 15.7-inch depth.

best-desk-pads-with-reference-charts-5.summary: AT-A-GLANCE's 2027 monthly desk pad calendar with Julian dates and ruled daily blocks.
best-desk-pads-with-reference-charts-5.description:
The AT-A-GLANCE pad is the closest thing here to a reference chart: its 2027 monthly pages include Julian dates, useful in logistics, manufacturing and scheduling, with ruled daily blocks.

AT-A-GLANCE says its paper resists ink bleed. It covers January to December 2027.
best-desk-pads-with-reference-charts-5.skipIf: Your year starts mid-2026; the 18-month calendar pad covers that.

best-desk-pads-with-reference-charts-6.summary: A PU leather desk protector 15.7 inches deep with a non-slip design.
best-desk-pads-with-reference-charts-6.description:
The Aothia is a simple PU leather protector described as guarding against scratches, stains, spills, heat and scuffs, large enough for a laptop, keyboard and mouse, with a non-slip design.

It has no printed content; it's a low-cost base surface.
cons: Full width not stated in summary
best-desk-pads-with-reference-charts-6.skipIf: You want real leather; the Elizo or YSAGi uses it.

best-desk-pads-with-reference-charts-7.summary: YSAGi's genuine cow leather desk mat with anti-slip rubber base, the most expensive here.
best-desk-pads-with-reference-charts-7.description:
The YSAGi Genuine Leather mat uses cow leather, which YSAGi says is handcrafted, on a rubber base with anti-slip lines. It is described as large and thick.

It was the most expensive pad here at the time of writing and has no printed content.
best-desk-pads-with-reference-charts-7.skipIf: Budget matters; the Aothia is a fraction of the price.

best-desk-pads-with-reference-charts-8.summary: A black-and-white June 2026 to December 2027 calendar that also works on a wall.
best-desk-pads-with-reference-charts-8.description:
The Aesthetic calendar runs from June 2026 to December 2027 in a minimalist black-and-white design, and can be used on a desk or a wall.

Its size isn't stated in the listing summary, so check whether it fits under your keyboard.
best-desk-pads-with-reference-charts-8.skipIf: You want a backboard to protect the desk; the 22 x 17-inch calendar pad includes one.

faq.a: Not among these listings. The AT-A-GLANCE calendar includes Julian dates, the nearest to a printed reference.

faq.q: Can I use a mouse on a calendar pad?
faq.a: Paper isn't designed for it. Keep a mouse pad beside the calendar.

faq.q: What date range do I need?
faq.a: Match it to your planning year; 18-month pads starting mid-2026 suit academic years.
Genuine leather, like the Elizo or YSAGi, costs more; PU wipes clean for less.

faq.q: Can I keep my own chart on a leather pad?
faq.a: Yes, beside the pad or under a clear protector, if you use one.

bottomLine: If you want information on the desk, the AT-A-GLANCE calendar with Julian dates is the closest to a reference chart here, and the 22 x 17-inch calendar pad adds a reusable backboard.
If you'd rather keep your own chart, pair it with a leather base: the Elizo set or YSAGi for genuine leather, or the Aothia or Gallaway for less.
